# awscc_iotsecuretunneling_tunnel (Resource)

A connection between a source computer and a destination device using AWS IoT Secure Tunneling.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) A short text description of the tunnel.
- `destination_config` (Attributes) The destination configuration for the tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_config))
- `tags` (Attributes List) A collection of tag metadata. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout_config` (Attributes) Timeout configuration for the tunnel. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeout_config))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the tunnel. Valid values are OPEN and CLOSED.
- `tunnel_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the tunnel.
- `tunnel_id` (String) A unique alpha-numeric tunnel ID.

<a id="nestedatt--destination_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_config`

Optional:

- `services` (List of String) A list of service names that identify the target application.
- `thing_name` (String) The name of the IoT thing to which you want to connect.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--timeout_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeout_config`

Optional:

- `max_lifetime_timeout_minutes` (Number) The maximum amount of time (in minutes) a tunnel can remain open.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iotsecuretunneling_tunnel.example
  identity = {
    tunnel_arn = "tunnel_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `tunnel_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the tunnel

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_iotsecuretunneling_tunnel.example
  id = "tunnel_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_iotsecuretunneling_tunnel.example "tunnel_arn"
```
